name: we-go/wp-go
description: Our WordPress features in one plugin, each turned on and off on the WP-Go screen: the block editor reworked, WordPress's CSS in the lowest cascade layer, Contact Form 7 forms built with ACF and mails in MJML, cache tags and a static cache, site texts, redirects, container pages, an editors' 404 page, Excel import and export, the dev tools' switch.
